questions.q: 12. In an election, a candidate secures 42% of the votes polled but is defeated by his only opponent by a majority of 3080 votes, because of 1400 invalid votes. The percentage of invalid votes is
questions.s:
12.(a)

Let the total votes be 100x

No of votes got by loser = 100x × 42% = 42x

No of votes got by winner = 100x × 58% = 58x

ATQ,

(58x - 42x) - 1400 = 3080

16x - 1400 = 3080

16x = 4480

x = 448016 = 280

Then, the total no of votes = 280 × 100 = 28,000

So, the percentage of invalid votes = 140028,000 × 100 = 5%

questions.q: 4. Sujata buys 9 apples and 8 mangoes for ₹276. When the cost of an apple is decreased by 10% and that of a mango remains the same, then the cost of 5 apples and 10 mangoes is ₹210. What is the original cost of 4 apples and 3 mangoes?
questions.s:
4.(a)

Let the cost of an apple= A

And the cost of a mango = M

ATQ,

9A + 8M =₹276 …..(1)

New rate of an apple = A ×910⇒9410

Now ,

5 ×9410 +10M =₹210

4.5A + 10M =₹210 …. × 2

9A + 20M = 420 …..(2)

By subtracting equation (1) from (2)

9A + 20M = 420

9A + 8M = 276

12M = 144

⇒M = 12

By putting value of M In equation (1)

9A + 96 =276

⇒9A = 180 so, A = 20

Therefore, original cost of 4 apples and 3 mangoes = 4×20 +3×12 =₹116

questions.q:
A person spends 30% of his salary. Salary of the person increases by 40% and savings increases by 10%. Find the percentage increase in the expenditure of the person.

एक व्यक्ति अपने वेतन का 30% व्यय करता है। व्यक्ति के वेतन में 40% की वृद्धि होती है और बचत में 10% की वृद्धि होती है। व्यक्ति के व्यय में प्रतिशत वृद्धि ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions.s:
Let, salary of the person = Rs. 100x

Expenditure of the person = 100x * 30/100 = Rs. 30x

Savings of the person = Rs. 70x

Salary after increment = 100x * 140/100 = Rs. 140x

Savings after increment = 70x * 110/100 = Rs. 77

Expenditure after increment = 140x - 77x = Rs. 63x

Required percentage increase in expenditure = (63x - 30x)/30x * 100 = 33/30 * 100 = 110%

questions.q:
The cost of Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) per litre is increased by 65%. By what percentage must Manish reduce his consumption of CNG so as not to increase his expenditure? (correct up to two decimal places)

प्रति लीटर संपीड़ित प्राकृतिक गैस (सीएनजी) की कीमत में 65% की वृद्धि हुई है। मनीष को अपने सीएनजी की खपत में कितने प्रतिशत की कमी करनी चाहिए ताकि उसका खर्च न बढ़े? (दो दशमलव स्थानों तक सही)
questions.s:
Let old price = P

New price = 165% of P = 1.65P

Old consumption = C, new consumption = C'

Since, expenditure is same =>

P * C = 1.65P * C'

C = 1.65C'

Reduction = C - C' = 1.65C' - C' = 0.65C'

% reduction = (0.65C'/C) * 100 = 65C'/1.65C' = 65/1.65 ≈ 39.39%

questions_hin.q_hi:
The cost of Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) per litre is increased by 65%. By what percentage must Manish reduce his consumption of CNG so as not to increase his expenditure? (correct up to two decimal places)

प्रति लीटर संपीड़ित प्राकृतिक गैस (सीएनजी) की कीमत में 65% की वृद्धि हुई है। मनीष को अपने सीएनजी की खपत में कितने प्रतिशत की कमी करनी चाहिए ताकि उसका खर्च न बढ़े? (दो दशमलव स्थानों तक सही)
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let old price = P

New price = 165% of P = 1.65P

Old consumption = C, new consumption = C'

Since, expenditure is same =>

P * C = 1.65P * C'

C = 1.65C'

Reduction = C - C' = 1.65C' - C' = 0.65C'

% reduction = (0.65C'/C) * 100 = 65C'/1.65C' = 65/1.65 ≈ 39.39%

questions_hin.q_hi: 2. राखी ने मोहन से 12 अंक अधिक प्राप्त किए। यदि राखी ने अधिकतम 200 में से 54% अंक प्राप्त किए। मोहन ने कितना अंक प्राप्त किया?
questions_hin.s_hi:
2.(d) राखी ने अधिकतम 200 में से 54% हासिल अंक = 108 अंकों
राखी ने मोहन से 12 अंक अधिक प्राप्त किए
तो, मोहन ने प्राप्त किया = 108 - 12 = 96 अंक
